rife-frame-interpolation-pipeline.description: Self-hosted RIFE video frame interpolation pipeline: turn footage into smooth 2x/4x/8x slow motion with on-device Practical-RIFE neural interpolation (CPU/CUDA/Apple MPS), no AI API key, storing source clips and renders in Backblaze B2 via the S3-compatible API. FastAPI + Next.js B2 sample app.

roboflow-inference-frame-archive.description: Full-stack B2 sample that runs Roboflow Inference on-device over each frame and archives every flagged detection — the JPEG frame, its prediction JSON, and an hourly Parquet roll-up — to Backblaze B2 over the S3-compatible API. Next.js 16 + FastAPI; B2 credentials are the only keys.

rosbag2-cloud-offload.description: Full-stack sample app that streams ROS 2 rosbag2 recordings off the robot into Backblaze B2 (S3-compatible), describes each session from rosbag2's own metadata, and catalogs them in Parquet so any bag is searchable and replayable with `ros2 bag play` from a presigned URL. Next.js 16 + FastAPI, one-click Vercel deploy.

sam2-mask-dataset-builder.description: Turn a raw media archive on Backblaze B2 into a versioned segmentation dataset. Drop click/box prompts, run Meta's Segment Anything 2 (SAM 2) locally to mask images and propagate across video, and write COCO RLE, mask PNGs, and cut-outs back to B2 — no second API key.

sdk-typescript.description: Backblaze-maintained TypeScript and JavaScript SDK for B2 Cloud Storage, currently incubating in Backblaze-Labs

speechbrain-call-center-analytics.description: On-device SpeechBrain call-center analytics: transcription, diarization & sentiment, all stored on Backblaze B2

supervision-sports-highlights.description: Computer-vision sports-highlights pipeline: detect, track, clip, annotate, and AI-summarize the action in a sports video, with Backblaze B2 (S3-compatible) as the sole data store. Built with Roboflow Inference + Supervision, ffmpeg, Claude, FastAPI, and Next.js.

titiler-cog-map-tiles.description: Serve dynamic XYZ map tiles on demand from Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs) in Backblaze B2 — a full-stack TiTiler + FastAPI + Leaflet sample that reads only the COG byte-ranges it needs over the S3 API, with no second tile server and no data duplication.

totalsegmentator-batch-pipeline.description: Batch medical-imaging pipeline that ingests 3D CT/MRI volumes to Backblaze B2, runs TotalSegmentator locally to produce multi-label masks over 100+ anatomical structures plus per-structure volumetrics, and writes masks and stats back to B2. Next.js 16 + FastAPI sample app over the B2 S3-compatible API.

transformerjs-background-removal.description: Browser-based AI image background removal app using Transformers.js and the RMBG-1.4 model, storing original and cutout images in Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage — no GPU or backend required.

transformers-video-object-detection.description: Real-time video object detection monitoring demo using Transformers.js and Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage. Runs YOLOv9 fully in the browser with automatic capture intervals, no server or GPU required. Detected snapshots and metadata are stored in low cost, scalable B2 storage for analysis and retention.

unsloth-lora-checkpoint-versioning.description: Unsloth LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning with full checkpoint versioning on Backblaze B2 — every dataset, per-epoch checkpoint, adapter, config, and metric is keyed under runs/<run_id>/. Real local fine-tunes of Llama/Qwen/Gemma on GPU (Unsloth) or CPU (transformers+PEFT); $0 per run, only B2 credentials.

vibe-coding-starter-kit.description: Starter kit for vibe coders building apps with file uploads and object storage. This full-stack dashboard template integrates with Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage and includes secure upload flows, file browsing, and basic storage management.

video-semantic-search.description: Chat with your video: a full-stack TypeScript + Python sample app that transcribes long-form video with Whisper, embeds it, and returns the exact timestamped moments that answer a natural-language question. Backblaze B2 is the sole data store — source, audio, transcript, and vector index — with no separate database.

video-to-insights-nvidia-parakeet-llama.description: AI-powered video analysis pipeline that downloads YouTube videos, stores durable artifacts in Backblaze B2, transcribes audio with NVIDIA Parakeet, generates timestamped insights with Llama 3.3, and serves interactive seekable video playback.

videohash-deduplication.description: Perceptual video deduplication on Backblaze B2: hash a video library with videohash, cluster near-duplicates by Hamming distance, and reclaim storage. Local, open-source, keyless compute — B2 holds the library, the hash index, and every cluster report.

voice-memo-ai-second-brain.description: Personal voice-memo second brain on Backblaze B2 — record, transcribe, tag, cross-reference, and summarize. FastAPI + Next.js reference app, no database, B2 is the source of truth.

webdataset-streaming-pytorch-training.description: Stream WebDataset shards straight from Backblaze B2 object storage into PyTorch training — no local staging disk. A FastAPI + Next.js sample app that packs media into .tar shards, writes them to B2, and streams them back as an IterableDataset with live throughput and a distributed worker/node shard split.

whisper-dataset-builder.description: Turn long-form audio on Backblaze B2 into a training-ready speech dataset: local pyannote VAD segmentation + faster-whisper transcription fan one recording out into many labeled clip/transcript pairs, written back to B2 as LJSpeech or HuggingFace audiofolder for ASR/TTS training.

whisper-subtitle-pipeline.description: Self-hosted batch video subtitling & translation built on faster-whisper and Backblaze B2 — transcribe and translate videos on-device (no per-minute API fees) and store source media plus SRT/VTT/JSON captions in one bucket. Next.js + FastAPI.

whisper-transformersjs-transcriber.description: Browser-based audio transcription using Whisper and Transformers.js, storing results in Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage.

whisperx-diarized-archive.description: Turn an audio/video library on Backblaze B2 into a searchable, speaker-labeled transcript archive. Local open-source pipeline — WhisperX transcription, pyannote diarization, sentence-transformers embeddings — with keyword + semantic search and a Next.js/FastAPI web UI.

yolo-drone-footage-detection.description: Full-stack Backblaze B2 sample app that runs Ultralytics YOLO object detection on drone and dashcam video, maps each detection against its GPS track, and stores the source video, annotated keyframes, per-frame JSON, and GeoJSON track in B2 over the S3-compatible API. Next.js + FastAPI.

yolo11-batch-detection-pipeline.description: Batch object-detection pipeline that runs Ultralytics YOLO11 (detect/segment) over an image/video library on Backblaze B2 S3-compatible storage, writing COCO JSON, annotated frames, and per-class instance crops back to B2.

yt-dlp-vod-archiver.description: Self-hosted VOD & live-stream archiver: download any yt-dlp-supported video, stream it straight to Backblaze B2 cloud storage, auto-cut highlight clips with ffmpeg, and browse it all from a Next.js + FastAPI UI. B2 sample app.

zeroshot-image-classifier.description: Browser-based image classification example application using OpenAI CLIP and Transformers.js. Upload images, run zero-shot classification with custom labels directly in the browser, and store images plus results in S3-compatible Backblaze B2 cloud object storage using pre-signed uploads.
